therapeutic_hypothesis.compound: Atezolizumab with or without Bevacizumab plus Cisplatin/Gemcitabine
therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: PD-L1 immune checkpoint blockade combined with VEGF inhibition and chemotherapy
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: T-cell activation and tumor angiogenesis inhibition
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with untreated, advanced biliary tract cancer

results.target_engagement_evidence: Atezolizumab serum concentrations achieved therapeutic levels (200-400 μg/mL post-dose)
safety_signals: 100% of participants experienced at least one adverse event
Serious adverse events included anemia, febrile neutropenia, neutropenia, thrombocytopenia, cardiac events, and gastrointestinal events
results.dose_information: Atezolizumab 1200 mg IV Day 1 q21d; Bevacizumab 15 mg/kg IV Day 1 q21d; Cisplatin 25 mg/m² IV Days 1,8 q21d cycles 1-8; Gemcitabine 1000 mg/m² IV Days 1,8 q21d cycles 1-8

context.duration: Up to approximately 14 months treatment, 23 months follow-up
